decisions.reason: As a Magento shop template it is close to the firm's hosting and shop-project know-how, so the firm can learn from customer use and improve it with relatively little capability stretch.
A responsive website template fits the firm's existing web, CMS, and agency-oriented service base, giving it strong absorptive capacity to refine and support the product.
Premium customer support sits at the core of the firm's established strengths in expert service and round-the-clock operations, so it is highly likely to be retained.
A software version management tool builds directly on the firm's technical platform, in-house development, and operational knowledge, making continued commercialization plausible.

An online tool for data processing contracts is relatively distant from the firm's core hosting and support knowledge, so despite some initial investment the firm is less able to interpret results and improve it efficiently.
